# SARTOR Lahore - Women's Bespoke Tailoring & Stitching Atelier
> Premier luxury bespoke couture atelier in Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan. Specializing in overseas diaspora bridal wear, royal ghararas, pishwas suits, digital biometric video sizing, pure hand adda embroidery (Zardozi, Dabka, Marori), and insured 7–10 business day worldwide DHL Express delivery to the UK, USA, Canada, and UAE.

## SARTOR Core Technical Safeguards
1. **2.5-Inch Internal Seam Margins**: Finished, dual-side overlocked alteration allowances on all bodices, kurtis, sleeves, and trousers for stress-free future resizing abroad.
2. **0.5-Inch Embroidery Border Clearance**: Hand embroidery held 0.5 inches inside structural stitch lines so local alteration needles never crush metallic bullion wires.
3. **3-Tier Canvas Waistband Suspension**: Internal multi-layer cotton canvas foundation dispersing 6–10 kg bridal and gharara skirt weights across pelvic crest, eliminating hip bruising and lower back strain.
4. **Ergonomic Scye Depth & Armhole Balance**: 1.5-inch deepened front-to-back armhole balance allowing 180-degree arm articulation without pulling hemline upwards during greetings and prayers.
5. **Pure Fiber Commitment**: Exclusively 80–110 GSM pure Katan silk, high-twist crinkle chiffon, French net, and breathable 100% pure Habotai silk or cotton mulmul linings (zero synthetic polyester).

## 4-Step Milestone Payment Framework
To ensure complete peace of mind for overseas diaspora clients without 100% upfront risk:
- **Step 1 (10% Token Booking)**: Virtual 1-on-1 biometric consultation with Master Tailor Abdul Ghaffar, design sketching, and permanent measurement logging on `app.sartor.pk`.
- **Step 2 (30% Adda Swatch Approval)**: 8x8-inch active wooden frame embroidery swatch executed with genuine metallic bullion wires and pearls; 4K macro daylight video verification sent via WhatsApp before garment panels are touched.
- **Step 3 (30% Mid-Production Panel Review)**: Video walkthrough of embroidered panels, basted bodice, and inner lining opacity before final edge-finishing (*magzi*) and assembling.
- **Step 4 (30% Final Dispatch Handover)**: 360-degree studio mannequin video inspection; balance settled upon video sign-off prior to sealed, insured DHL Express dispatch.

- [The Farshi Lehenga & Barat Trail Engineering Guide: Structural Bustle Loops & Weight Distribution for Overseas Venues](https://sartor.pk/blog/farshi-lehenga-barat-trail-bustle-loop-guide): How SARTOR integrates hidden French bustle loop buttons, internal grosgrain wrist loops, and 3-tier canvas waistband suspensions into heavy 1.5–2.5 meter bridal trails, redistributing 8–14 kg weight onto pelvic iliac crests for seamless transitions between ceremonial entry walks and ballroom reception dancing in London, Toronto, and Dallas.
- [16-Kali vs. 24-Kali Skirt Flares: Calculating Kalidar Panel Ratios, Yardage, and Grainline Alignment (Taar)](https://sartor.pk/blog/16-kali-vs-24-kali-lehenga-flare-grainline-guide): Mathematical breakdown of skirt flare volume, waist-to-hem panel ratios, yardage formulas across 44" and 54" panna fabrics, and true vertical warp grainline (Seedha Taar) alignment to eliminate post-cleaning seam twisting (kaan).
- [The Pakistani Bridal Lehenga Can-Can & Canvas Blueprint: 3-Tier Waistband Suspension vs. Scratchy Mesh](https://sartor.pk/blog/pakistani-bridal-lehenga-cancan-canvas-waistband-blueprint): 3-tier woven cotton canvas waistband suspension transferring 6–10 kg skirt weight onto pelvic iliac crests; modular detachable tiered crinoline with horsehair braid hemlines and Habotai silk skin buffers.
- [The Sharara vs. Gharara Masterclass: Drape Physics, Ruched Knee-Joints, and Fabric Requirements for Overseas Weddings](https://sartor.pk/blog/sharara-vs-gharara-masterclass-drape-physics-overseas-brides): Architectural dissection between continuous flare Farshi Shararas and ruched Awadhi Ghararas, hidden bias-cut silk elastic knee expansion channels eliminating joint tourniquets when sitting during the Nikah, 80 GSM pure Katan silk drape physics, and 1.5-meter Farshi train French bustle systems.
